0.0: #h0#, I was watchin' you mine earlier, and I was wonderin' if you could show me a thing or two... Huh! Guess you must be a master Miner now! Well, I suppose congratulations are in order, eh?

no.0: Sure, we can celebrate anytime until #rJanuary 31, 2011#k.
